title: Space-time is derived from the event tree and observer dependent

statements.text: Space-time is not a basic concept in Dendrogramic Holographic Theory: it is derived from the treelike structure of events an observer collects, so it is subjective and observer dependent.

sources.quote: space-time is not considered as the basic concept, but it is derived from treelike structure of events collected by an observer. In this way, spacetime is subjective
